blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Primitive computational structures (data rakhne ke basic dhaanche), jaise lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs, ki definition (tareef) aur purpose (maqsad) bata sakenge.
Alag alag computational structures ki characteristics (khaas baatein) aur properties pehchan aur bata sakenge.
In structures par basic kaam kar sakenge: insertion (daalna), deletion (nikaalna), traversal (har item se guzarna) aur searching (dhoondna).
Stack mein LIFO (Last-In, First-Out: jo aakhir mein aaye woh pehle nikle) aur queue mein FIFO (First-In, First-Out: jo pehle aaye woh pehle nikle) ka principle (usool) samajh aur bana sakenge.
Trees aur graphs ki alag alag types ka comparison (muqabla) kar sakenge aur un par suitable (munasib) operations laga sakenge.
Masle ki zaroorat, data ki arrangement (tarteeb) aur performance (raftaar) dekh kar sab se suitable structure chun sakenge.
Asal zindagi mein computational structures istemal kar sakenge, jaise data ko organize karna, task scheduling (kaamon ki bari tay karna) aur network modeling.
Mushkil masle hal karne aur kaam behtar banane ke liye alag alag structures ko mila kar istemal kar sakenge.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum important (zaroori) computational structures (data ko rakhne aur sambhalne ke tareeqe) dekhenge: lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs. Yeh programming ki base (bunyaad) hain. Hum in ki properties (khaas baatein), operations (in par kiye jane wale kaam) aur inhein efficiently (kam waqt aur kam mehnat mein) banane ka tareeqa parhenge. Phir hum dekhenge ke kisi masle ke liye sahi structure kaise chunte hain, aur asal zindagi mein in ka istemal kaise hota hai. Chapter ke aakhir tak aap in structures ko alag alag jagahon par sahi tarah istemal karna seekh lenge.

Roz ki zindagi mein hum aksar data ko organize karte (tarteeb se rakhte) aur sambhalte hain. Maslan phone mein contacts save karna, karne wale kaamon ki to-do list banana, ya kitchen mein plates ek ke oopar ek rakhna. Isi tarah computer ko bhi data organize karna aur sambhalna hota hai. Computational structures is kaam mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Roz ki har misal ko us structure se milaiye: to-do list, plates ka dher, bank ki line.
blocks.explanation: To-do list: list; plates ka dher: stack; bank ki line: queue.

items: Computational structures data ko organize karte hain: lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs.
